questions.stem: Which factor would cause the LOWEST rate of transpiration?

options.text: Bright light, cool temperature, low humidity, still air
Darkness, cool temperature, high humidity, still air
Darkness, warm temperature, low humidity, windy
Bright light, warm temperature, low humidity, windy

questions.explanation: Transpiration is lowest when stomata are closed (darkness), temperature is low (less evaporation), humidity is high (smaller gradient), and air is still (humid layer builds up around the leaf).
